item.title: Surf closes $407M fiber ABS
item.description: Surf Internet closed a $407 million inaugural fiber asset-backed securitization (ABS) to support its continued network expansion across the Great Lakes region. #pressrelease

item.title: Congressman Guthrie still wants action on the 1992 Cable Act
item.description: Independent cable operators are encouraged that Rep. Brett Guthrie still sees good reason to change the Cable Act of 1992, but the coming midterm elections could shift the priorities of the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

item.title: Siemens delivers verified AI-driven cybersecurity solution for industrial 5G with Palo Alto Networks
item.description: Combines Siemens' private 5G infrastructure and continuous monitoring with Palo Alto Networks' AI-driven cybersecurity solution. #pressrelease

item.title: Eurobites: Telefónica adopts digital twin tech for more efficient data centers
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Cassava helps governments get control of the cloud; German fiber groups sound off on Digital Networks Act; VMO2 hires new CFO.

item.title: Meizu exits handset business as sector braces for brutal 2026
item.description: Chinese handset brand Meizu shuts mobile business due to intense competition and rising memory costs amid other recent exits and expected drop in demand.

item.title: Aspire Fiber gets majority investment from Arenova Capital
item.description: Arenova Capital, a Dallas-based growth equity firm, will invest $50 million of equity capital into Aspire Fiber to fuel the company's network expansion. #pressrelease

item.title: Charter's HFC upgrade will be half done by year-end, CEO says
item.description: Charter's multi-phased HFC upgrade is slated to be 50% complete by the end of 2026. Separately, Charter plans to accelerate DOCSIS 4.0 upgrades in Cox territories after the merger closes.

item.title: FCC's Carr pitches plan to apply spectrum to 'weird space stuff'
item.description: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr proposed has announced a plan to bring more spectrum in support of orbital projects for telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C) for future orbital labs, satellite repairs and private inhabitable spacecraft.

item.title: Global AI glasses shipments reach 8.7M units with Mainland China emerging as fastest-growing market – Omdia
item.description: Meta remains the dominant force globally, holding the largest share of the global market at 85.2%. #pressrelease

item.description: MWC26 welcomed nearly 105,000 attendees for a week of AI, innovation and industry-defining debate as well as boundary-pushing new features Airport of the Future, New Frontiers and robots of all shapes and sizes. #pressrelease
